notesStmt.note: This manuscript was almost certainly written during the days just before or after January 1, 1889.
This is a draft of the poem "To the Year 1889," first published in the 5 January 1889 issue of The Critic and later included in Good-Bye My Fancy (1891) under the title "To the Pending Year."
